text:
aj: Heads-up — noticed a 30-40% p99 increase on paged-attn routes after the kernel-selection tweak merged yesterday. Repro steps and quick profile below, need a fast triage.

maria: ugh. which tweak? the threshold change for flash vs fused?

aj: yeah, commit 9f3b2d4 — changed heuristics to favor fused-attn at seqlen<1024 for GPU32. On dedicated tests p50 looks fine, but p99 on long-context chat workloads jumps.

kyra: can you paste the perf runs? numbers+what trace you used.

aj: pasted below (shortened):

```
Before (master@9f3b2d4~): route=flashattn_v2, seq=2048, kv-cold
  p50=18ms p95=62ms p99=110ms
After (master@9f3b2d4): route=fused_attn_opt, seq=2048, kv-cold
  p50=20ms p95=85ms p99=152ms
```

aj: trace shows big stall during kv-cache refill on step ~3 with fused path. profiler shows higher kernel launch overhead + a few larger memcpy spikes.

perf-bot: Profiling snapshot (top lines):
```
- kernel_launch_overhead: +42% (fused vs flash)
- memcpy_async: +3.8x in kv-rebuild path
- occupancy_util: fused 0.6 vs flash 0.72
```

maria: memcpy async spike is suspicious — are we accidentally moving KV to GPU more frequently with fused? maybe fused path invalidates prefix caching?

sandeep: I ran a minimal repro w/ kv warm vs cold. Warm runs equalize (<5% diff). Cold runs diverge a lot. That points to extra work on first requests (kv construction/packing).

kyra: any differences in kernel selection logs? AJ can you grab route selection debug for the failing requests?

aj: pasted excerpt: 
```
[TRACE] route_select: preferred=fused_attn_opt (heuristic score 0.78)
[TRACE] fused_attn_opt: requires_kv_pack=true
[TRACE] kv_cache: cold -> allocating packed buffer (size 34MB)
[DEBUG] performing pack memcpy_async (src=host staging, dst=gpu)
```

maria: ah — looks like fused path uses packed KV format requiring an explicit pack memcpy on cold paths; flashattn uses incremental KV append that avoids a large memcpy. The heuristic swap caused us to pick fused and pay that cold-start cost.

sandeep: quick mitigation: change kernel selection to prefer flashattn when kv_cache_cold==true, or delay the pack by doing lightweight append + background pack. Which is less risky?

kyra: for hotfix I'd prefer selection rule change: cheap to roll forward and roll back. Background pack is nicer long-term but riskier.

aj: agree. I can push a tiny revert-style patch that checks kv_cache_state in selector. Proposed pseudo:
```
if kv_cache_state == COLD and seq_len >= 1024:
  prefer = flashattn
else:
  use normal heuristics
```

maria: test matrix we should run after patch: 
- p99 cold-end-to-end under chat workload (seqs 1500-2500)
- long-run warm cache stability
- microbench kernel launch + memcpy profiles

perf-bot: queued a canary throughput job on dedicated: job/attn-smoke-1777 (3 instances, gpu32, load=80% traffic). I will post results when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for patch/kv-cold-selector-hotfix to canary env at 2026-04-01T21:15:00Z

aj: thanks. if canary looks good we'll roll to prod and then follow up with background-pack design doc. Also need an issue for benchmarking different pack strategies (async overlap, pinned host buffers).

kyra: filing issue now and adding triage notes. tagging perf infra to keep an eye. :eyes:

maria: one more note — add metrics for pack memcpy counts so we can alert on sudden increases.

sandeep: on it, will add a short-lived metric and a dashboard panel for kv_pack_activity.

aj: sweet. will update thread with canary numbers. cheers everyone :thumbsup:
